summary: Join our Banking Supervision and Regulation Training Course to master the principles of financial regulation and ensure compliance in the banking sector.
lede: Banking supervision assesses banks’ prudential risks and helps determine where oversight or corrective action is needed. This training is for bank supervisors, prudential analysts, and compliance teams who turn bank data and inspection evidence into clear supervisory action. Participants learn to assess capital, liquidity, and asset-quality signals, prioritize reviews using risk-based supervision, and plan inspections with follow-up on findings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with bank oversight, prudential analysis, supervisory reviews, and regulatory enforcement. It suits people who need to turn bank data, inspection evidence, and regulatory expectations into clear supervisory action.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet tool, plus the ability to open Word or PDF supervisory documents. You should also be ready to review sample bank returns, prudential ratios, inspection notes, and scenario worksheets during exercises. Prior exposure to banking regulation is expected; this is not an introductory banking course.
